summary: XTL Biopharmaceuticals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders convened on June 22, 2026 was adjourned for one week due to lack of quorum. The meeting will reconvene on June 29, 2026 at the same time and place. No business agenda, proposal details, or special situation event is described. This is a routine procedural adjournment notice by a foreign private issuer.
